title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts (docs/site + examples)
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and three docs quickstarts (RAG basics, agent tool-calling, and deployment considerations). No breaking changes. Backwards-compatible docs and examples only.
description: Context: we want to provide engineers with ready-to-run RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and concrete tool-calling examples to speed adoption and reduce onboarding friction. This PR adds: 1) RAG agent template set (python and typescript) with config examples for embeddings, chunking, and caching; 2) three quickstart guides for the docs site (RAG quickstart, Agent tool-calling quickstart, and Private deployment considerations for agents); 3) example apps under redwood-examples that demonstrate streaming responses, tool invocation, and structured outputs; 4) small docs-site sidebar and redirect updates to surface the new content. Checklist: [x] unit tests for example harness (integration mocked), [x] docs site build passes locally, [x] quickstarts include runnable snippets and minimal config, [x] examples reference supported models and quantization notes. Related: follows patterns from prior RAG/agent quickstarts (see PRs ~30000-30600). Why: reduce time-to-first-success for teams evaluating agent/tool-calling on Redwood and provide canonical patterns for prefix caching and fallback routing. Testing: verified local docs build, smoke-ran examples against the sandbox account with mocked index; CI runs: docs-build, examples-tests, lint, types-check. Merge: squash and merge after final approval.

Sofia: Nit on quickstart step ordering and missing note about model size recommendations for Dedicated capacity. Reply: reordered steps and added guidance for Dedicated/Private deployments.

notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on correctness of the agent/tool-calling examples (are the CLI commands minimal and repeatable?), accuracy of the docs guidance for Dedicated/private deployments, and whether the quickstarts surface recommended SLOs and cost-control knobs. The examples use the sandbox API key pattern in .env.example and include a no-cost mock mode for CI.

documentation_impact: Adds three new quickstarts and multiple example repos. Sidebars updated to surface the content under Guides > Agents and Guides > RAG. Redirects added for older RAG doc URLs.
